L’idée m’est venue après avoir vu sur Tw: The idea came to me after seeing a site on Twitter that listed the birthplaces of all the players taking part in the 2026 World Cup in July 2026.
Il y a cinq pages principales sur le sit: The site has five main pages:
elle permet d’accéder à une carte intera: it gives access to an interactive map showing the birth and death places of the listed people, with a filter system.
elle permet d’obtenir différentes statis: it gives various statistics about the results of a search made with the filters, notably as charts.
disponible uniquement sur PC, elle perme: available on PC only, it generates a csv file usable in QGIS from the selected filters. For this QGIS map, I was mostly inspired by the “Plan cartes” videos from Les Échos, here is the
elle permet d’obtenir d’autres statistiq: it gives other statistics about the ranking of names/towns/countries, etc. against a score, and the male/female ratio by town/country/age, etc.
disponible uniquement sur PC, elle regro: available on PC only, it gathers the games of the site. For now there are two, and in both you can choose the filters to decide which kind of people will appear.
à chaque round, deux personnes vous sont: at each round, two people are shown and you must guess which one was born first. You have 3 lives.
à chaque round, une personne vous est pr: at each round, a person is shown (name and photo) and you must place a pin on the map where they were born. Each round earns 0 to 2000 points depending on the distance between your pin and the real birthplace. Three difficulty levels: on easy the country and continent of birth are shown, on normal only the continent, on hard no hint.
Le site a été conçu et développé pour êt: The site was designed and developed to be used on PC. It is therefore best used on a computer, even though it still works on a phone.
Comment marche le calcul du classement ?: How does the ranking calculation work?
Pour classer un utilisateur, j'utilise 5: To rank a user, I use 5 metrics:
Le nombre de liens sur la page de l'util: The number of links on the user's page:
Selon moi, plus une personne cite de per: In my view, the more real people a person cites on their page, the more important they are.
Le nombre de personnes qui ont l'utilisa: The number of people who link to the user on their page:
De plus, plus une personne est citée, pl: Also, the more a person is cited, the more important they are.
La taille de la page Wikipédia de l'util: The size of the user's Wikipedia page:
Plus la taille de la page est grande, pl: The bigger the page, the more the person has to say about their life.
Plus une personne a d'amis, plus elle es: The more friends a person has, the more connected and important they are.
Plus la page d'une personne est traduite: The more languages a person's page is translated into, the better known they are internationally.
Ensuite, pour effectuer le calcul, je pr: Then, to do the calculation, I take the result of the 5 variables and weight them on a precise unit so that no variable weighs more than the others.
Voici quelques explications techniques p: Here are a few technical explanations for those who are interested. The site was coded with React + Vite and TypeScript, with a UI/UX based on shadcn/ui, Radix and Tailwind CSS. On the backend, it runs on Django with a PostgreSQL database.
Pour récupérer les informations des page: To get the information from the Wikipedia pages, I downloaded the French Wikipedia ZIM file of February 23, 2026. I then wrote a Python script that keeps only people who really existed. The script is 99% accurate, so you may, very rarely, find pages that do not correspond to real people.
J’ai ensuite développé un script permett: I then developed a script to get the information of each page. It works well, but it is impossible to guarantee 100% retrieval of the information for more than 700,000 pages.
Les informations d'une page sont considé: A page's information is considered valid once a certain number of people have validated it with the “Validate this person's information” button on the profile.
En pourcentage, il y a très peu d'utilis: In percentage terms, very few users have wrong data, and most of the time it is because the layout of a Wikipedia page is not uniform from one page to another, which makes it hard for my code.
De même, toutes les nouveautés apportées: Likewise, anything added to the pages after February 23, 2026 (people who died, new links added to a page, new information, etc.) is not available on the site except through an individual report. The project is open source and available here:
Toutes les informations présentes sur ce: All the information on this site comes from Wikipedia and does not belong to me.
